limits: Exact Tb counter-ion, numerical sorption temperature and per-strain mass absent from the inspected methods

Solution depletion alone cannot distinguish all sorption/precipitation losses or establish isolated recovery
No real-feed, Tb-selective, desorption/reuse, isolated-product or industrial outcome established
